title: fix: preserve upstream RESOURCE_LIMIT through CFG preparation
body:
CP6-BASELINE-COMPAT-001: validation of the same valid Publication with a restricted operational budget now preserves `RESOURCE_LIMIT` through CFG preparation and W5. Previously the new upstream diagnostic fell through to generic `INCOMPLETE_VALIDATION`; two baseline tests reproduced that loss before implementation.

This is WORK-CFG-029, a post-CP5 compatibility remediation. CP5 remains APPROVED / MERGED. This PR awaits human review; no merge, auto-merge, CP6 or baseline synchronization is authorized.

## Contract

`CfgBuildCoordinator` classifies complete typed diagnostic counts in this order: `INVALID_IR`, `RESOURCE_LIMIT`, `VALIDATION_LIMIT`, `UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY`, generic `INCOMPLETE_VALIDATION`, projection `UNSUPPORTED_INPUT`, then `CFG_BUILT`. `RESOURCE_LIMIT` means this validation execution could not finish under its operational budget. It is distinct from invalidity, unsupported capability, legacy validation preconditions and source uncertainty.

Only `CFG_BUILT` can contain a graph. Composition maps the new status to `EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_LIMIT` before opening an AnalysisSession or creating keys, solver state, observations, consumers or a prepared result. The CLI maps real `AirJsonException.Code.RESOURCE_LIMIT` to exit 7 and `EXTERNAL_RESOURCE_LIMIT` on stderr, with no result file, stdout receipt or delivery attempt. Generic incomplete and `IMPLEMENTATION_LIMIT` retain separate handling. Result/receipt wire versions are unchanged.

CORE-SIZE-001 remains absolute: program size/resource availability is never a semantic admission criterion. The same Publication succeeds with sufficient resources, fails operationally with an explicit small budget, then succeeds again. No semantic partial result or artificial source remainder is produced.

## Exact dependencies and scope

- Only air-java repinned: `ce530a7e17ab12b23c48f29425f503ff920b09fb` → `17029898fd0ee8fabcaaae89f7260148633d4b12`; source tree `6f863c3321b6cbf82b021d85b47cab02748eed78`.
- Fresh exact-source build and isolated Maven repository; source/JAR provenance is checked locally and in CI. Local Java 25.0.4 emits release 21; CI uses Java 21.
- analysis-ir remains `122ce54e1b9ef9b00646f93ece409ca8b63bc933`. E2E frontend/lower stay at the CP5 pins. Original sibling checkouts are unchanged.
- Exactly five production files change: CfgBuildCoordinator, CfgBuildResult, AnalysisDataflow composition, DataflowAirReader and AnalysisDataflow CLI. The configurable real-codec adapter is the narrow seam for controlled operational CLI tests.
- 74 production files preserved byte-for-byte, including W1–W4 and W5 default plan, result capture, wire, writer and receipt. Historical CP5 evidence/inventories/approved heads remain frozen.

## Validation

- Required baseline RED: two failures, zero errors/skips, old `VALIDATION_LIMIT` expectation observed generic `INCOMPLETE_VALIDATION`. New typed oracle also RED before production.
- `mvn clean verify`, fast, architecture, semantic, integration, performance and full: PASS. W1–W5: PASS. Scope/manifest and diff checks: PASS.
- Nine compiled focal mutants killed; each has baseline GREEN, compile PASS, nominal RED, byte-exact restore and individual second GREEN. Includes collapse to legacy `VALIDATION_LIMIT`. No compilation failure counted. One setup attempt stopped before mutation because its baseline selector omitted WireTest; retained separately.
- Two fresh real CP4E pipelines: PROGA from real Assign with original origin; model/source/effective remainders `false/true/true`. A/B deterministic and result bytes equal the approved CP5 result, SHA-256 `aacb6e6cedbd7d1dbbd44e7a476b398df3eeff51f1a63b90257d4dc412705dec`.
- CP3 COMPLETE with zero writes/queries/facts. OLDER → NEWER keeps only NEWER with last Assign support. Memory/file/CLI results remain semantically and byte-wise identical.

Evidence: [WORK-CFG-029 validation](https://github.com/Gustavo2358/analysis-cfg/blob/d083870b38c2b49bcad93eec17895cc6102019ca/docs/work/evidence/WORK-CFG-029/validation.md), [contract](https://github.com/Gustavo2358/analysis-cfg/blob/d083870b38c2b49bcad93eec17895cc6102019ca/docs/architecture/resource-limit-preflight.md), [mutants](https://github.com/Gustavo2358/analysis-cfg/blob/d083870b38c2b49bcad93eec17895cc6102019ca/docs/work/evidence/WORK-CFG-029/mutations/receipt.json), [source preservation](https://github.com/Gustavo2358/analysis-cfg/blob/d083870b38c2b49bcad93eec17895cc6102019ca/docs/work/evidence/WORK-CFG-029/source-preservation.json).

W3-PERF-01, W3-METRICS-01, broader baseline synchronization and 117k qualification remain open/out of scope. CP6_BASELINE remains blocked pending this remediation's review/merge; CP6 remains NOT_STARTED / NOT_AUTHORIZED.
